create_sources_plot_config: create a plotting configuration for Torax runs focusing on source profiles with temperature, density, current, and power axes
build_figure_properties: build a FigureProperties layout with 2 rows and 4 columns for multi-axis Torax simulation plots
configure_plot_properties: configure PlotProperties with attribute names, LaTeX labels, and y-axis units for a Torax subplot
set_time_series_plot_type: set PlotType.TIME_SERIES for 0D profiles plotting as a function of time in Torax power plots
suppress_zero_values: suppress all-zero data values in Torax source profile plots using suppress_zero_values flag
